analysis.title: Russell 2k Futures: Mixed Flows Surrounding Recent Credit Concerns
key_insights: Deterioration in High Yield credit pressured Russell 2k on October 14th. CDX 5 Year High Yield spreads widened to a 6 month high, with CoreWeave contagion cited as a major catalyst.
GS's High Yield Debt Sensitive basket fell 4.9% on October 14th. Russell 2k, which contains many sub-investment-grade companies, fell 1.9%.
Russell 2k futures aggregate open interest rose $1.8bn, the largest 1 day move in 2026 excluding roll periods.

Lower price with higher open interest signaled short selling. Richer funding spreads indicated long buying also took place, with Russell 2k 3 month funding rising in outright terms and relative to S&P.

Hedge funds likely initiated the downside. Since July, weekly changes in Russell 2k hedge fund shorts (Commitment of Traders) have correlated positively with CDX High Yield, so shorts rose when credit worsened.
The identity of the contrarian buyers, and whether they provide ongoing support, is unknown. Russell 2k futures held up through a widespread equity sell-off in early trading on October 15th.
risk_factors: High yield credit deterioration, with CDX 5 Year High Yield at a 6 month wide, spilling into small caps with many sub-investment-grade companies.
CoreWeave contagion as a catalyst for credit stress.
Unknown identity and staying power of the contrarian buyers supporting Russell 2k futures.
